results.title: انخفاض داو جونز.. مؤشرات الأسهم الأمريكية تغلق على تراجع
results.description: أغلقت المؤشرات الرئيسة في بورصة وول ستريت الأمريكية على تراجع في ختام تعاملاتها مساء الجمعة، وسط مخاوف متزايدة إزاء الإنفاق الضخم للشركات المرتبطة بالذكاء الاصطناعي على التكنولوجيا الناشئة. وأنهى المؤشر ستاندرد آند بورز 500 التداول منخفضًا بمقدار 139.30 نقطة، أو 1.80%، إلى 7580.21 نقطة. بورصة وول ستريت وخسر المؤشر ناسداك المجمع 747.73 نقطة، أو 2.84%، ليغلق عند 25440.68 نقطة. وانخفض المؤشر داو جونز الصناعي 571.98 نقطة، أو 1.09%، إلى 51770.58 نقطة.
creator: واس - نيويورك

results.title: ScienceOra Demonstrates AI-Assisted Hydrogen-Production Catalyst Design Workflow at Tencent Global Digital Ecosystem Summit
results.description: The workflow spans literature analysis, candidate design, experimental planning and industrial decision support, extending AI4S into materials research SHENZHEN, China, Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wenge AI demonstrated an AI-assisted hydrogen-production catalyst design workflow supported by ScienceOra at the 2026 Tencent Global Digital Ecosystem Summit. The demonstration showed how AI for Science (AI4S) can connect literature analysis, catalyst candidate design, experimental planning and industrial decision support, helping materials researchers translate scientific evidence into actionable research plans. ScienceOra is Wenge AI's intelligent research decision platform, built on the ScienceOne Scientific Foundation Model. For specialist research tasks such as materials development, the platform brings together scientific models, professional literature, research data and tools to support information access, research-plan development and scientific decision-making. ScienceOra plans and executes a five-step catalyst design workflow From literature analysis to catalyst candidate design The demonstration focused on the design of a high-entropy alloy catalyst for the alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction. To address the need for high activity and durability, ScienceOra searched professional literature and drew on published research methods and elemental properties to support the development of candidate designs. It also cross-checked optimization proposals against relevant literature, providing researchers with references that could be reviewed and verified. Rather than simply generating material formulations, the workflow connects documentary evidence, materials knowledge and specific design objectives to support more targeted analysis of candidate solutions. Researchers remain responsible for assessing scientific validity and determining subsequent research directions. From experimental planning to industrial decision support For experimental planning, ScienceOra can assist in developing research protocols around candidate designs, helping researchers organize experimental variables and producing testing standard operating procedures (SOPs) and related reference information for subsequent validation. For industrial applications, the platform can also support comparative analysis across dimensions such as the feasibility of scaled hydrogen production, performance at industrially relevant current densities, durability, raw-material availability and compatibility with mass-production synthesis processes. It can then assist in establishing decision priorities, screening criteria and process-improvement recommendations. Candidate designs, experimental plans, process recommendations and references can be consolidated into a structured research report, helping R&D teams assess scientific evidence alongside engineering constraints. AI provides analytical and decision support, while experimental testing and scientific validation remain essential parts of materials research. Previously disclosed collaboration reports design efficiency and activity improvements In a previously disclosed industry–research collaboration on hydrogen-production catalyst design, ScienceOra supported literature analysis and research-plan development. The collaboration reported a 38% improvement in catalyst activity and reduced the design stage from several months to 30 minutes. The case illustrates the potential of domain-specific AI to connect scientific literature, research design and engineering requirements. ScienceOra was recently made available on Tencent WorkBuddy, with an initial offering of more than 30 research expert agents and skills covering literature analysis, research hypotheses, plan design, modeling and simulation, validation analysis and research communication. The conference demonstration further illustrated how ScienceOra can be applied to specialist materials research, as AI4S moves beyond general information processing toward support for research workflows and industrial R&D decision-making. For more information, visit https://www.scienceone.ai/portal/. About Wenge AI Wenge AI (1956.HK) is a provider of artificial intelligence technology and service platform products for enterprises. With self-developed large models as its core, the company helps enterprises build practical intelligent platforms and applications. Founded by a team of AI scientists from the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Wenge AI has deep technological expertise in large models, cognitive intelligence and complex-system modeling, and is committed to advancing AI from technological capabilities to enterprise-level applications.

results.title: Saudi foreign minister discusses regional security with Russian, Canadian and EU officials
results.description: ATLANTA — Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan held separate meetings with his counterparts from Russia and Canada, as well as the European Union's foreign policy chief, on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta. During his meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, Prince Faisal reviewed bilateral relations and discussed major regional developments, particularly the escalation in Yemen and continuing threats to maritime navigation through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab Al-Mandab Strait. The two ministers also explored efforts to enhance regional security and promote stability. In a separate meeting Friday, Prince Faisal met Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand to discuss bilateral relations and the latest developments in the region. Both sides condemned the Houthi militia's continued attacks against Saudi Arabia and emphasized the importance of efforts to achieve regional security and stability. Prince Faisal also met Kaja Kallas, the European Union's high representative for foreign affairs and security policy and vice president of the European Commission. Their discussions focused on regional and international developments, with both sides reaffirming the importance of maintaining security and stability in the region.
creator: saudi gazette

results.title: Ronaldo hits 985 career goals with hat-trick, moves within 15 of historic 1,000-goal milestone
results.description: RIYADH — Cristiano Ronaldo scored a sensational 15-minute hat-trick to reach 985 career goals as Al Nassr defeated Al Kholood 5-3 in an eight-goal thriller at Al Awwal Park on Thursday. The Portuguese superstar struck three times between the 66th and 81st minutes to turn a tightly contested match into a crucial victory for the defending Roshn Saudi League champions, moving within just 15 goals of the historic 1,000-goal milestone. Watching from the stands was undefeated world heavyweight boxing champion Oleksandr Usyk, who was left in awe of Ronaldo's performance. The Ukrainian boxing legend described the five-time Ballon d'Or winner as "an alien" when asked by the Saudi Pro League about the Al Nassr captain."Great win, great team performance. Happy to help with a hat-trick!" Ronaldo wrote on social media after collecting another Man of the Match award. Despite the final score, Al Nassr faced a stern challenge from an Al Kholood side determined to end a four-match winless streak. Julien Domingues stunned the hosts with the opening goal in the 16th minute before Angelo equalized eight minutes later. Sadio Mane then put Al Nassr ahead before halftime, with Joao Felix providing the assists for both goals. However, Al Kholood refused to surrender, and Loic Essomba restored parity in first-half stoppage time to send the teams into the break level at 2-2. Ronaldo, who had seen earlier efforts ruled out, finally broke through in the 66th minute, timing his run perfectly to convert Felix's cutback and restore Al Nassr's lead. Six minutes later, the same combination struck again as Felix delivered a cross from the right for Ronaldo to power a header into the net. The Portuguese midfielder finished the match with four assists, becoming only the second player in RSL history to achieve that feat in a single match. Ronaldo completed his hat-trick in the 81st minute after Mane picked him out inside the penalty area, allowing the Al Nassr captain to finish clinically and claim his fourth hat-trick of the season. Domingues converted a stoppage-time penalty for his second goal of the night, but Al Nassr had already secured the three points. The victory lifted Al Nassr to 28 points from 11 matches, one behind league leaders Al Qadsiah, who maintained their advantage with a commanding 6-0 win over Al Riyadh. Tijjani Reijnders scored a hat-trick for Al Qadsiah, while Julian Quinones also found the net as Brendan Rodgers' side continued their impressive start to the campaign. For Ronaldo, the latest treble marked another remarkable chapter in his pursuit of 1,000 career goals, bringing him within touching distance of a milestone never previously achieved at the highest level of professional football. And for Usyk, who has built his own legacy in the boxing ring, Ronaldo's extraordinary longevity and scoring ability were enough to earn a simple verdict: "An alien."

results.title: أعلى مستوى منذ أبريل.. ارتفاع أسعار النفط 2% عند التسوية
results.description: ارتفعت أسعار النفط أكثر من 2% مساء الجمعة، لتسجل أعلى مستوياتها عند التسوية منذ أواخر أبريل. وصعدت العقود الآجلة لخام برنت تسليم ديسمبر 2.76 دولار، أو 2.4%، إلى 117.64 دولارًا للبرميل عند التسوية بعد أن لامست مستوى مرتفعًا عند 118 دولارًا للبرميل. أسعار النفط وزاد عقد برنت تسليم يناير الأكثر تداولًا 2.63 دولار إلى 113.43 دولارًا للبرميل. وارتفعت العقود الآجلة لخام غرب تكساس الوسيط الأمريكي 2.12 دولار، بما يعادل 2.08% إلى 104.12 دولارات. وعلى أساس شهري، حقق خام برنت مكاسب 13.6%، وزاد الخام الأمريكي 15.2%.
creator: واس - هيوستن
